import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer

)

# Function to calculate multi-class log loss given one-hot encoded labels and predicted probabilities
def calc_multiclass_logloss(true_labels_onehot, probs):
    """Calculate multi-class log loss: -(1/N) * sum_i sum_j (y_ij * log(p_ij))"""
    eps = 1e-15
    probs_clipped = np.clip(probs, eps, 1 - eps)
    loss = -np.mean(np.sum(true_labels_onehot * np.log(probs_clipped), axis=1))
    return loss
